title: Install named program catalogs and CICS transfer/linkage
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of program_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: The generic program catalog installs immutable content identities by case-insensitive program name and positive generation, rejects conflicting generation reuse, and resolves exact or latest generations.
XCTL replaces the current frame at constant depth with raw COMMAREA bytes; LINK pushes a child frame; RETURN pops it and writes returned bytes to its caller.

Frames clone the complete Invocation contract, preserving principal, capabilities, resource limits, trace, idempotency, cancellation, bindings, provider generations, and audit correlation without JSON batch assumptions.
All 26 CSD program definitions install and resolve at generation 1; the exact name/identity catalog digest is recorded.

commands.result: program catalog generation and frame tests passed
